assets.role: stable and frequent card-back material family
assets.prompt: Full-bleed vertical playing-card back surface design for a premium friendly cartoon solitaire game. Emerald green woven felt and soft leather texture, a large simple symmetrical botanical vine medallion in warm brushed brass, four small ivory leaf accents, dark forest-green shadow channels, subtle hand-painted paper grain, broad readable shapes, clean soft bevels, restrained warm highlights. Fill the entire canvas edge-to-edge as a flat orthographic texture, centered and vertically symmetrical, readable at tiny mobile-card size. No card object, no surrounding scene, no mockup, no outside drop shadow, no letters, no numbers, no suit symbols, no UI text, no watermark, no photorealism.
assets.style_reference_prompt: 2D premium mobile cartoon game art; hand-painted gouache surfaces; rounded chunky forms; emerald, warm cream and brushed brass palette; one clear focal motif; low visual noise; tactile but not photorealistic; cozy botanical conservatory card table. Never render text.

critique.notes: clear emerald/brass identity; botanical emblem remains readable at 58x80; no text or rule state
